b: I have been trying to improve how we handle sales call follow ups, particularly keeping the CRM updated, but not every detail from a call is worth recording, though. The next person probably doesn't need to know how long the meeting lasted, but they do need to understand the customer's concerns, what questions came up and whether there's anything we're supposed to follow up on.

We are looking into using AI to take some of the note-taking off the team's hands, but generic summaries aren't much help if everyone has to go back and fix them. Anyone already using AI in sales, how do you get it to pick up on the details that actually matter when moving a deal forward?
